parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: ContainerGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECI instance. This is also the ID of the container group.
